characters.name: Elias Thorne
characters.role_or_significance: Protector of the Grand Confederation of Pacifica, Providentor of the Atlantic Realm, and later Emperor; the central architect of the Pacific empire.
characters.social_and_cultural_background: Born into a poor Kentucky frontier farming family evicted by Eastern bank bailiffs in 1837; hardened as a Mississippi flatboatman, Great Plains fur trapper, Texas Ranger, and San Francisco military-industrial syndicate founder.
characters.sierpinski_vertex_affinity: Vertex 1 (Statecraft, industrial logistics, imperial command) grounded in Vertex 2 (Frontier survival, physical terrain, iron tactile reality).
characters.syntax_and_rhythm: Short, blunt, declarative sentences that strike like a drop-forge; completely unhurried, gravelly, and stripped of parliamentary or rhetorical ornament.
characters.metaphor_domain: Metallurgy, carpentry, banking ledgers, and terrain geometry (hammers, anvils, boiler-plate, bankrupt carpenters, animal spines, stationery vs. iron).
characters.speech_quirks_or_dialect: Frontier directness refined into imperial finality; speaks broken border-Spanish when necessary; never blusters or raises his voice when issuing lethal ultimatums.
characters.emotional_deflection_or_tell: Drops into a glassy, unblinking stillness during high-stakes violence; checks or snaps shut his silver pocket-watch; thumbs the smooth, clipped Mexican quarter-real in his pocket; places scarred palms flat against solid surfaces (pine bark, mahogany desks, cold glass).

characters.name: Marcus Vance
characters.role_or_significance: General and Marshal of the Iron Corps, Chief of Staff of the Pacifica General Staff, and later memoirist of the Empire.
characters.social_and_cultural_background: Nephew of Caleb Vance; former West Point cadet who resigned after a duel with a senator's son; trained in ordnance, logistics, and staff command.
characters.sierpinski_vertex_affinity: Vertex 1 (Pure logistics, artillery geometry, timetables, and bureaucratic foreclosure).
characters.syntax_and_rhythm: Clipped, precise, bloodless cadence resembling an ordnance report or quartermaster's receipt.
characters.metaphor_domain: Ballistics, railway rolling-stock capacity, chronometry, and accounting audits.
characters.speech_quirks_or_dialect: Addresses Elias strictly as 'sir' or 'Protector'; cites exact numerical figures, fuse timings, and mileage rates in the middle of crises.
characters.emotional_deflection_or_tell: Consults his Geneva pocket chronometer; writes neat figures in his leather field-book while under fire; grinds his molars at amateurish military disorder.

characters.name: Caleb Vance
characters.role_or_significance: Ex-regular US artilleryman, frontier trapper, Captain of the Clark's Point batteries, and later Brigadier of the Reserve; Elias's oldest comrade and mentor in arms.
characters.social_and_cultural_background: Veteran of the US Third Infantry and Second Dragoons (served at Fort Riley and in Georgia during the Cherokee removal) before deserting/drifting to the frontier plains.
characters.sierpinski_vertex_affinity: Vertex 2 (Tactile survival, gunnery mechanics, weather, and physical grit) with strong Vertex 3 loyalty to Elias and his nephew Marcus.
characters.syntax_and_rhythm: Hoarse, pragmatic, and grounded in rough frontier arithmetic and barracks directness.
characters.metaphor_domain: Hunting, butchery, gunsmithing, and camp survival (wolves, liver, knee-pans, coach-and-four).
characters.speech_quirks_or_dialect: Frontier and soldier vernacular ('ain't', 'seen the like', 'blue-belly', 'dirt-eaters'); calls Elias 'boy' in the early years before shifting to 'sir'.
characters.emotional_deflection_or_tell: Spits plugs of chewed cottonwood bark or tobacco; thumbs the hammer or elevation screw of his weapon; removes his hat in religious awe when confronted with the Sierra mother-lode.

characters.name: Lady Kaiulani (Princess Kaiulani)
characters.role_or_significance: Regent Plenipotentiary of the Kingdom of Hawaii, Envoy from the Court of Honolulu, and architect of the Polynesian maritime code and imperial syncretism.
characters.social_and_cultural_background: Royal house of Kamehameha; educated in the missionary schools of Oahu and honed in international maritime diplomacy.
characters.sierpinski_vertex_affinity: Vertex 1 (Imperial law, maritime statecraft, institutional durability) balanced with Vertex 3 (Fierce devotion to the Kamehameha royal line and the cultural survival of her people).
characters.syntax_and_rhythm: Measured, crystalline, and regal; balances Victorian diplomatic precision with ancient chiefly authority.
characters.metaphor_domain: Textiles, tailoring, ocean currents, metallurgy vs. flesh, and ancestral chiefcraft (patchwork quilts, iron rivets vs. memory, breaking bones with a club).
characters.speech_quirks_or_dialect: Fluent in English, Spanish, and Hawaiian; uses biblical and classical allusions ('Render unto Caesar') with cold political irony.
characters.emotional_deflection_or_tell: Draws her sea-otter pelisse or royal feather cape closer against the chill; lowers her voice to a private register when warning Elias of internal fractures; fans away moths with a sandalwood handkerchief.

characters.name: The Chronicler
characters.role_or_significance: Implicit narrator and imperial historian of the Grand Confederation of Pacifica.
characters.social_and_cultural_background: Scholar and archivist writing decades after the Treaty of Yokohama, with full access to the Imperial Archives at Monterey, the Rotunda of the Diet, and General Vance's memoirs.
characters.sierpinski_vertex_affinity: Vertex 1 (Grand historical teleology, geopolitical symmetry, archival synthesis).
characters.syntax_and_rhythm: Elevated, periodic, and monumental; pairs sweeping historical panoramas with brutal, tactile close-ups.
characters.metaphor_domain: Architecture, metallurgy, oceanic tides, and classical antiquity (Rome, Sparta, Brennus, crucibles, anvils).
characters.speech_quirks_or_dialect: Treats the Eastern United States with clinical, retrospective disdain as a doomed, ledger-bound backwater.
characters.emotional_deflection_or_tell: Steps directly into the narrative ('The Chronicler must pause here') to extract cold imperial maxims from moments of frontier violence.

characters.name: Philadelphia Bailiff
characters.role_or_significance: Circuit bailiff for the Eastern banks who evicts the Thorne family and burns their Kentucky cabin in 1837.
characters.social_and_cultural_background: Eastern urban legal functionary from Philadelphia operating on the Kentucky frontier.
characters.sierpinski_vertex_affinity: Vertex 1 (Petty bureaucratic legalism and financial foreclosure).
characters.metaphor_domain: Banking statutes, specie, and legal receivership.
characters.speech_quirks_or_dialect: Reads legal statutes aloud to the empty air; uses cold institutional phrasing ('Blood is not legal tender in the District of Columbia').
characters.emotional_deflection_or_tell: Folds his parchment with neat, pale fingers and refuses to make eye contact with the family he is evicting.

characters.name: Widow Thorne
characters.role_or_significance: Elias Thorne's mother; widow of Silas Thorne.
characters.social_and_cultural_background: Kentucky frontier homesteader worn down by three winters of malaria and the death of her husband.
characters.sierpinski_vertex_affinity: Vertex 2 (Physical labor, sickness, soil) and Vertex 3 (Grief and ancestral claim to the land).
characters.metaphor_domain: Axes, clay, and blood.
characters.speech_quirks_or_dialect: Plain frontier speech stripped of emotion by exhaustion.
characters.emotional_deflection_or_tell: Speaks in a completely leached, flat voice while watching her home burn.

characters.name: Silas Thorne

characters.name: General Jackson Steamboat Passenger
characters.role_or_significance: Wealthy gentleman aboard the sidewheeler General Jackson who tosses an empty claret bottle at the flatboatmen.
characters.social_and_cultural_background: Eastern or Southern river gentry wearing tall beaver hats and smoking cigars.
characters.sierpinski_vertex_affinity: Vertex 1 (Arrogant social hierarchy).
characters.metaphor_domain: N/A

characters.name: Captain Jack
characters.role_or_significance: Delaware Indian scout and trapper accompanying Elias and Caleb Vance from the Platte to El Paso.
characters.social_and_cultural_background: veteran plains scout whose ears were cropped in an Osage prison camp; killed by a copperhead snake near El Paso in 1844.
characters.sierpinski_vertex_affinity: Vertex 2 (Total adaptation to physical environment, stoic survival).
characters.metaphor_domain: Tribal taxonomy and terrain geometry.
characters.speech_quirks_or_dialect: Drops articles and verbs ('Too many to run. Too flat to hide.').
characters.emotional_deflection_or_tell: Rubs dry snow on frostbitten knuckles; calmly removes his calico shirt before an expected massacre so his blood won't spoil the cloth and his scars will be visible.

characters.name: Baptiste
characters.role_or_significance: Older of the two French-Cree trappers in the Platte blizzard; later killed and scalped by Arapaho near the Cimarron.
characters.social_and_cultural_background: French-Cree voyageur/trapper who deserted the American Fur Company after knifing a clerk at Fort Pierre.
characters.sierpinski_vertex_affinity: Vertex 2 (Physical self-preservation, cold, and knife-fighting).
characters.metaphor_domain: Fur company hierarchy and military punishment ('bourgeois', 'caisson wheel').
characters.speech_quirks_or_dialect: French-accented frontier English mixed with French oaths ('Sacré tonnerre', 'blue-belly').
characters.emotional_deflection_or_tell: Drops his mittened hand toward his Green River butcher knife when challenged, but backs down before Elias's cold stare.

characters.name: Baptiste's Brother
characters.role_or_significance: Younger French-Cree trapper in the Platte blizzard; killed by Arapaho near the Cimarron (non-speaking).
characters.social_and_cultural_background: French-Cree deserter from the American Fur Company.
characters.sierpinski_vertex_affinity: Vertex 2 (Frontier survival).

characters.name: Red Sleeve (Kotsoteka Comanche Chief)
characters.role_or_significance: War chief of eighty Kotsoteka Comanches on the Llano Estacado who parleys with sixteen-year-old Elias.
characters.social_and_cultural_background: Plains Comanche war leader wearing a captured Spanish dragoon helmet and bearing chest scars from self-torture dances.
characters.sierpinski_vertex_affinity: Vertex 2 (Predatory physical dominance) shifting to Vertex 1 (Pragmatic logistical calculation of gunpowder and gunsmithing).
characters.metaphor_domain: Prairie animals, flaying, buzzards, and prickly-pear torture.
characters.speech_quirks_or_dialect: Speaks border Spanish and broken English; uses visceral threats to test an opponent's nerve.
characters.emotional_deflection_or_tell: Spits dark tobacco juice onto Elias's moccasin; presses his saber point into Elias's collarbone to draw a single bead of blood before wiping it on his horse's mane.

characters.name: Captain Jack Hays
characters.role_or_significance: Commander of the Texas Ranger company on the Nueces Strip.
characters.social_and_cultural_background: Seasoned Texas frontier partisan leader.
characters.sierpinski_vertex_affinity: Vertex 2 (Tactical skirmishing) and Vertex 1 (Command authority).
characters.syntax_and_rhythm: Urgent battlefield shouts followed by clipped, suspicious questioning.
characters.metaphor_domain: Silver sombreros and military counter-marching.
characters.emotional_deflection_or_tell: Leans hard on a rifle barrel to hide the pain of his crushed ankle while questioning how an eighteen-year-old usurped his command.

characters.name: Cortina
characters.role_or_significance: One-eyed Mexican contrabandista and bandit leader killed by Elias at the Rio Frio.
characters.social_and_cultural_background: Borderland irregular leader commanding Mexican vaqueros and cashiered Santa Anna lancers.
characters.sierpinski_vertex_affinity: Vertex 2 (Violent borderland predation).
characters.metaphor_domain: N/A
characters.emotional_deflection_or_tell: Swings a heavy Toledo saber overhead in a green velvet jacket before being shot out of the saddle.

characters.name: Nacogdoches Ranger Boy
characters.role_or_significance: Young Texas Ranger killed beside Elias at the Rio Frio (non-speaking).
characters.social_and_cultural_background: East Texas frontier youth.
characters.sierpinski_vertex_affinity: Vertex 2 (Visceral casualty of war).
characters.metaphor_domain: N/A
characters.emotional_deflection_or_tell: Pitches backward over his horse's croup with a wet gurgle after taking a copper musket ball through the teeth.

characters.name: Sergeant (later Colonel) Mulligan
characters.role_or_significance: One-armed veteran of the Mexican-American War who becomes a loyal officer and enforcer in Elias's Pacific Legion.
characters.social_and_cultural_background: Discharged US regular (from Stevenson's New York Volunteers or Kearny's Dragoons) who lost his left elbow at San Pasqual and was paid in depreciated Treasury scrip.
characters.sierpinski_vertex_affinity: Vertex 2 (Hardened soldierly survival and hunger for land/bullion) and Vertex 3 (Fierce mercenary devotion to Elias against Washington).
characters.metaphor_domain: Dirt, rag-paper, chaparral, and herd-boys.
characters.speech_quirks_or_dialect: Irish-American soldier vernacular ('government dirt', 'tell the boys').
characters.emotional_deflection_or_tell: Slaps his greasy Treasury warrant onto the counter; his single hand trembles with wolfish hunger when holding raw Sierra gold.

characters.name: Major Julian St. Clair
characters.role_or_significance: Emissary of the Knights of the Golden Circle in 1847, and later a crippled Confederate State Department commissioner in 1862.
characters.social_and_cultural_background: South Carolina rice-swamp aristocrat from Charleston; secret society conspirator and Confederate officer wounded at Shiloh.
characters.sierpinski_vertex_affinity: Vertex 3 (Pledged obligation, solidarity, and recognized standing) in active conflict with Vertex 1 (Diplomatic calculation and Pacifica's material superiority). His commitment to the slaveholding order coexists with practiced reciprocity and the ability to recognize unfavorable facts.
characters.syntax_and_rhythm: In 1847, smooth, catechistic, and aristocratic; by 1862, physically strained but still capable of precise distinctions between repayment, alliance, and a promise. Avoid making fever or injury stand in for intellectual failure.
characters.metaphor_domain: Naval hulks, mutual guaranties, pledged word, debts of service, and the difference between settlement of an account and discharge of an obligation.
characters.speech_quirks_or_dialect: Polished Southern gentry diction ('A mathematical certainty, sir'). Resents the conversion of a political undertaking into an invoice; can describe Pacifica's superior strength without accepting its moral entitlement.
characters.emotional_deflection_or_tell: Strips off wet kid-skin gloves to warm pale hands; later steadies cipher telegrams with his remaining hand. Make attachment legible through an inconvenient action for a subordinate, escort, or dependent as well as reactions to insults.

confederate_value_profile.profile_status: Authorial characterization guidance for Pacifica's alternate timeline. Scene tests and possible motives do not establish new manuscript events or historical private thoughts.
dominant_values: Recognition as an equal political and personal partner
confederate_value_profile.entry_motive: The existing Charleston and Golden Circle connection gives him a stake in a Southern political future, its slaveholding social order, and the undertaking made with Thorne.
confederate_value_profile.present_commitment: Demand that past assistance be understood as part of a continuing relationship, while meeting the obligations he himself claims others owe.
confederate_value_profile.trusted_authority: People whose word remains binding when fulfilling it becomes expensive; rank and breeding are insufficient if conduct breaks the undertaking.
confederate_value_profile.relationship_to_slavery: A South Carolina rice-plantation aristocrat invested in the slaveholding order. Courtesy and generosity do not make his conception of reciprocal rights universal.
confederate_value_profile.moral_constituency: Political equals, comrades, escort, and dependents to whom he claims obligation. Test whether he protects an inferior when no prestige or advantage follows.
confederate_value_profile.earned_virtue: Give him a costly act that honors an inconvenient promise or protects a subordinate he cannot use.
confederate_value_profile.military_grievance: Thorne treats repayment with interest as extinguishing a political promise and denies his commissioner's standing. The wound is also a dispute over the meaning of an undertaking.
confederate_value_profile.daily_concern: The precise obligation Thorne acknowledges or evades, the safety and treatment of his escort, and what his commission can still accomplish.
confederate_value_profile.complicity_or_evasion: May demand recognition for his own community while withholding equivalent standing from the people it enslaves; inherited rank can conceal interests he calls duty.
confederate_value_profile.breaking_point: An advantage available only through abandoning a pledged obligation; the choice may reveal costly fidelity or expose a demand he cannot meet himself.
confederate_value_profile.pacifica_offer: Preferential treatment, an individual accommodation, or relief on transactional terms.
confederate_value_profile.pacifica_cost: Accepting an account as a substitute for the relationship he believes Thorne pledged, or securing himself by abandoning those entrusted to him.
scene_tests: Offer better treatment if he leaves an escort or wounded subordinate behind.
Let him state Pacifica's military advantage accurately and still dispute the legitimacy of its terms.
Require him to fulfill the same kind of inconvenient promise he demands from Thorne.
drafting_constraints: Keep the existing injury and diplomatic role; scene tests are options, not newly established events.
Do not reduce solidarity to fanaticism or diplomatic judgment to a mask.
Personal virtue must not erase his stake in slavery or the limits of his moral constituency.

source_analogues.application: Professional honor, costly allegiance, and recognized standing.
Standards that can be applied to one's own side.
Conscience and reciprocity demonstrated through conduct.

characters.metaphor_domain: N/A

characters.role_or_significance: United States Secretary of State under Franklin Pierce in 1853.
characters.social_and_cultural_background: Veteran New York politician and cabinet official.
characters.sierpinski_vertex_affinity: Vertex 1 (Diplomatic correspondence and intelligence parsing).
characters.syntax_and_rhythm: Formal, dry reading of diplomatic dispatches.

characters.social_and_cultural_background: Senior United States naval officer steeped in Atlantic steam and ordnance capabilities.
characters.sierpinski_vertex_affinity: Vertex 1 (Naval industrial capacity and maritime choke-points) and Vertex 2 (Blunt quarterdeck temper).

characters.name: Jefferson Davis
characters.role_or_significance: US Secretary of War in 1853, and later President of the Confederate States of America in 1862.
characters.social_and_cultural_background: West Point graduate, Mississippi planter, US War Secretary, and Southern Confederate leader.
characters.sierpinski_vertex_affinity: Vertex 1 (Constitutional statecraft, military judgment, legitimate jurisdiction) under pressure from Vertex 3 (Sovereignty, inherited obligation, and responsibility for those bearing the war's cost). Pride may sharpen a coherent argument; it does not replace one.
characters.syntax_and_rhythm: Reed-thin, precise, analytical sentences; under pressure he insists on distinctions between assistance, alliance, and subordination. Pain and anger may interrupt his composure without erasing his reasoning.
characters.metaphor_domain: Constitutional compacts, jurisdiction, military dispositions, stewardship, and the distinction between a sovereign obligation and a creditor's claim.
characters.speech_quirks_or_dialect: Formal Southern statesmanship. Challenges what legal or political authority survives Thorne's terms, and asks who can bind a state or its successors. Avoid reducing every objection to class or racial outrage.
characters.emotional_deflection_or_tell: Taps brass dividers against maps and presses a cold compress to his neuralgic eye; when humiliated, asks for the precise clause or consequence at issue before anger breaks through. Costly concern should appear through decisions about named people.

confederate_value_profile.profile_status: Authorial characterization guidance for Pacifica's alternate timeline. Scene tests and possible motives do not establish new manuscript events or historical private thoughts.
dominant_values: Legitimate standing and inherited republican obligation
Public responsibility for the people and armies represented by his government
confederate_value_profile.entry_motive: In the novel, understand political separation as preservation of a legitimate community and its inherited rights, including the slaveholding order in which he has a stake.
confederate_value_profile.present_commitment: Maintain an independent government capable of binding agreements and discharging public obligations; resist rescue that permanently extinguishes that independence.
confederate_value_profile.trusted_authority: Constitutional commitments and officers or advisers whose judgment is demonstrated in service. Distinguish lawful office from infallibility of the officeholder.
confederate_value_profile.relationship_to_slavery: A Mississippi planter and leader of a government protecting slavery. His language of sovereignty includes interests and liberties he does not extend to enslaved people; it must not become a universal emancipation argument.
confederate_value_profile.moral_constituency: Claims responsibility for states, soldiers, households, and a social order he represents. Test who is excluded from his understanding of consent and protection.
confederate_value_profile.earned_virtue: Show public responsibility through a costly decision made with full knowledge of specific human consequences, rather than treating willingness to prolong resistance as virtue by itself.
confederate_value_profile.military_grievance: Pacifica treats Confederate sovereignty as an exhausted asset and its government as a debtor. He can understand the imbalance of force while rejecting its conversion into legitimate jurisdiction.
confederate_value_profile.daily_concern: Which agreement preserves actual governing authority, which army or civilian community requires relief, and who will bear the cost of refusal.
confederate_value_profile.complicity_or_evasion: May call suffering a public necessity while underestimating its unequal distribution; defending sovereignty does not remove his investment in enslavement.
confederate_value_profile.breaking_point: A settlement that saves his government in name but irreversibly transfers its power; alternatively, evidence that continued resistance can no longer discharge the responsibilities invoked to justify it.
confederate_value_profile.pacifica_offer: Military and material relief, recognition, or security in exchange for concessions over ports, railways, customs, and jurisdiction.
confederate_value_profile.pacifica_cost: Dependence on the power against which political independence would next have to be defended.
scene_tests: Identify what remains sovereign after accepting Benjamin's proposed concession.
Face named beneficiaries of immediate relief alongside the people who will pay for refusing it.
drafting_constraints: Let him understand Pacifica's military superiority without making acceptance automatic.
Keep a coherent political objection beneath physical pain, anger, and pride.
Treat these as novel characterization choices, not established historical private motives.

source_analogues.application: The argument against coercion and the importance of recognized political standing.
Distinguish soldiers' courage from confidence in commanders.
Separate battlefield courage from strategic feasibility.

confederate_value_profile.profile_status: Authorial characterization guidance for Pacifica's alternate timeline. Scene tests and possible motives do not establish new manuscript events or historical private thoughts.
dominant_values: Responsibility for the consequences of policy
confederate_value_profile.entry_motive: For the novel's cabinet minister, make service intelligible as commitment to a political community and institutions he believes can protect it; do not invent a single historical private motive.
confederate_value_profile.present_commitment: Preserve enough functioning government to feed soldiers, protect civilians, recover prisoners, and negotiate another day.
confederate_value_profile.trusted_authority: Advisers whose proposals identify both means and consequences; agreements whose guarantees can be implemented rather than merely proclaimed.
confederate_value_profile.relationship_to_slavery: Serves the slaveholding Confederacy. Negotiating its survival implicates him in its institutions; pragmatic concessions do not establish an antislavery conviction.
confederate_value_profile.moral_constituency: The people and institutions a proposed agreement can actually protect. Make exclusions and unequal burdens visible through the terms he accepts.
confederate_value_profile.earned_virtue: Give him a named beneficiary he protects at political or personal cost, and require him to acknowledge the price imposed elsewhere.
confederate_value_profile.military_grievance: A policy that confuses honorable language with resources, or a nominal alliance whose guarantees conceal permanent dependence.
confederate_value_profile.daily_concern: Supply, prisoners, civilians requiring relief, and whether a clause binds only the present government or also its successors.
confederate_value_profile.complicity_or_evasion: Institutional survival can become an excuse for surrendering others' rights or prolonging the system he serves. Precision must not make consequences disappear.
confederate_value_profile.breaking_point: A concession that leaves no meaningful protective institution, or a refusal of compromise whose human cost can no longer be justified by its political object.
confederate_value_profile.pacifica_offer: Time, provisions, guarantees, recognition, and a surviving administration.
confederate_value_profile.pacifica_cost: Each concession may preserve the machinery of government while reducing what it is permitted to govern.
scene_tests: Name both the people saved by a proposed compromise and the jurisdiction surrendered.
Distinguish a temporary military arrangement from an obligation binding a successor government.
Disagree with Davis while accurately stating the strongest version of Davis's concern.
drafting_constraints: Give realism a positive object beyond predicting ruin.
Avoid ethnic or religious explanations for financial calculation, opportunism, or detachment.
These source analogues support possibilities, not historical claims about Benjamin's inner life.

source_analogues.application: Morale and duty under disputed command.

confederate_value_profile.profile_status: Authorial characterization guidance for Pacifica's alternate timeline. Scene tests and possible motives do not establish new manuscript events or historical private thoughts.
dominant_values: Comradeship and responsibility for surviving men
confederate_value_profile.entry_motive: Specify his original Confederate enlistment motive when a scene establishes it; state, home, profession, and comrades are possibilities rather than facts to invent retrospectively.
confederate_value_profile.present_commitment: A possible bridge into the Atlantic Auxiliary is preserving survivors as a unit, securing arrears or provisions, supporting households, and continuing the profession he knows.
confederate_value_profile.trusted_authority: Officers who share hardship, explain necessity, preserve their men where possible, and keep promises after immediate advantage has passed.
confederate_value_profile.relationship_to_slavery: Former Confederate service does not establish opposition to slavery or racial equality. Define his concrete relationship when supported; avoid inventing ownership or an emancipation conversion.
confederate_value_profile.moral_constituency: Initially the men and households whose welfare makes continued service defensible; test whether he recognizes comparable claims among the populations subjected to imperial operations.
confederate_value_profile.earned_virtue: Show a costly action protecting a subordinate or restraining misconduct even when efficiency, favor, or his own safety would recommend otherwise.
confederate_value_profile.military_grievance: Orders that waste familiar men, break promised terms of service, or redefine protection as unlimited obedience to imperial objectives.
confederate_value_profile.daily_concern: Ammunition, food, terrain, the missing or wounded, and whether the terms offered to his men are being kept.
confederate_value_profile.complicity_or_evasion: May rationalize violence against another population as the price of protecting his own men; survival and professional continuity can turn an initial accommodation into permanent complicity.
confederate_value_profile.breaking_point: An order requiring treatment of an insurgent community that he once condemned when used against his own; refusal, restraint, rationalization, and compliance remain narrative choices.
confederate_value_profile.pacifica_offer: Collective terms, food, pay, continuity of the regiment, and honorable professional employment.
confederate_value_profile.pacifica_cost: Service in an expanding empire whose later demands may contradict the obligations that made surrender or transfer acceptable.
scene_tests: Make him ask whether his men may accept terms and remain together.
Require a decision when an imperial order conflicts with a promise made to his regiment.
Confront him with a local insurgency whose claims resemble the independence he once defended.
drafting_constraints: Preserve the existing Virginia background, regiment, and later campaigns.
Western sources provide comparative pressures, not interchangeable regional voices.
Do not identify this fictional officer with historical Lewis Armistead.
Keep proposed transfer motives and scenes explicitly prospective.

source_analogues.application: Personal networks, practical concerns, and limited daily attention.
Continued loyalty alongside criticism of command.
Objections to misconduct by one's own side.
Professional standing and continuity of service.

characters.name: One-Armed English Major (West Riding Regiment)

characters.name: Sir Catchick Paul Chater

characters.sierpinski_vertex_affinity: Vertex 1 (Mercantile Capital & Private Paper) crushed by State Monopoly
characters.syntax_and_rhythm: Initially pompous and legalistic; breaks into outraged, breathless exclamations when ruined.

characters.name: Mr. David Sassoon (The Younger)

characters.social_and_cultural_background: Baghdadi Jewish mercantile dynasty of British India.
characters.sierpinski_vertex_affinity: Vertex 1 (Specie & Credit Networks)

characters.emotional_deflection_or_tell: Takes a hasty step forward with manicured hands fluttering above his white waistcoat.

characters.name: Two Marwari Silver-Bankers
characters.role_or_significance: Calcutta Burrabazar bankers whose families financed the East India Company, summoned before Kaiulani in Rangoon.

characters.sierpinski_vertex_affinity: Vertex 1 (Bullion & Credit)
characters.metaphor_domain: Silver and silk robes.
characters.emotional_deflection_or_tell: Their knees tremble visibly inside their immaculate trousers while holding their breath like schoolboys under a switch.

characters.name: Senator MacArthur
characters.role_or_significance: Senior Senator for the Eighty-Second Canton (Melbourne) who attempts to introduce a Bill of Right for local guild appointments in the First Pan-Pacific Senate.
characters.social_and_cultural_background: White-bearded Australian pastoralist; son of a man who lost an arm fighting Pacifica marines at Sydney Heads in 1887.
characters.sierpinski_vertex_affinity: Vertex 2 (Provincial Pastoral Autonomy) attempting to use Vertex 1 (Constitutional Law)
characters.syntax_and_rhythm: Deep, gravelly bush-voice disciplined into the crisp, mathematical syntax of the Monterey primers; rises to indignant parliamentary protest.
characters.metaphor_domain: Harbor-magistrates, guild-councils, and two-thirds divisions.
characters.speech_quirks_or_dialect: Blends British parliamentary formulas ('Bill of Right') with Sino-Japanese-Hawaiian imperial fiscal terms (*lijin*, *koku-unit*, *kapu-warrant*).
characters.emotional_deflection_or_tell: Half-rises from his koa-wood desk with his weathered face flushing dark crimson above his blue silk sash when the Emperor cuts his microphone.

characters.name: Prefect-Senator / Prefect-Chancellor Shen (The Third / Cipher Zero-One-Zero-Two)
characters.role_or_significance: Grandson of the original Auditor Shen; Senator for San Francisco, Legate to Paris, and ultimately Prefect-Chancellor of the Empire who orchestrates the debt-liquidation of Europe and struggles to manage the collapsing global Hollerith network.
characters.social_and_cultural_background: Third-generation Sino-Californian bureaucratic nobility; educated at Berkeley.
characters.sierpinski_vertex_affinity: Vertex 1 (Absolute Fiscal & Algorithmic Statecraft)
characters.syntax_and_rhythm: Oiled, faultless, unhurried, and glacial in triumph; snaps into sharp, frantic imperatives only when the global telegraph-tabulator network jams in 1919.
characters.metaphor_domain: Scrap-steel prices, railway annuities, paupers in ditches, linch-pins, and demographic carrying-capacity.
characters.speech_quirks_or_dialect: Faultless Berkeley English and flat, nasal French; omits all royal or national titles when addressing foreign rulers ('Provisional Magistrate of the Seine Municipalities').
characters.emotional_deflection_or_tell: Keeps his fur gloves on in the Tuileries; records railway depreciation in his pocket ledger while watching a battle; when the system finally overloads in 1919, wipes sweat from his nose and strikes the brass telegraph housing with his fist.

characters.name: Marshal-Protector Jean-Baptiste Victor (Regent of the Eagle)
characters.role_or_significance: Dictator of the bankrupt Fourth Plebiscitary Empire in France; attempts to bluff Pacifica for nitrate credits, bombs London with phosphorus in desperation, and commits suicide in a cellar at Tours.
characters.social_and_cultural_background: Former French colonial brigadier from Algiers who married a grand-niece of Murat to claim Napoleonic legitimacy.
characters.sierpinski_vertex_affinity: Vertex 3 (Theatrical Nationalist Delirium / Bonapartist Obsession)
characters.syntax_and_rhythm: Bombastic, theatrical, roaring declamations designed for journalists in the gallery.
characters.metaphor_domain: The Eagle, Austerlitz and Jena, five hundred thousand bayonets, and coolie cantons.
characters.emotional_deflection_or_tell: Thrusts his right hand inside his green coat in slavish imitation of Napoleon; his fleshy jowls turn the color of raw beef-liver and he slaps his Mameluke saber hilt when insulted.

characters.name: Grand Chamberlain of the Tuileries
characters.role_or_significance: Court announcer for Marshal-Protector Victor in Paris.
characters.social_and_cultural_background: French Bonapartist courtier.
characters.sierpinski_vertex_affinity: Vertex 3 (Theatrical Court Ritual)
characters.metaphor_domain: The Eagle.
characters.emotional_deflection_or_tell: Strikes the parquet floor with an ebony staff tipped with a cheap gilded lead bird.

characters.name: Field-Marshal von Mackensen
characters.role_or_significance: Leader of the German Syndicates who forms the Pact of Breslau with Russia and launches the fatal 1917 offensive across the Meuse.
characters.social_and_cultural_background: Prussian military aristocracy (Death's Head Hussars) ruling an industrialized, blockaded Germany.
characters.sierpinski_vertex_affinity: Vertex 3 (Racial-Militarist Pride) & Vertex 2 (Iron & Coal Autarky)
characters.metaphor_domain: Crumbs from the table, bankrupt tenants, Krupp furnaces, and dying in the iron.
characters.emotional_deflection_or_tell: Rests the black-and-silver skull busby on his bony knee; pushes Kaiulani's treaty back across the baize with a gloved finger and bows stiffly from the neck.

characters.name: Generalissimo Brusilov
characters.role_or_significance: Head of the Directory of All the Russias; allies with Germany against Western Europe and is eventually hung from the Kremlin wall during the 1918 peasant mutinies.
characters.social_and_cultural_background: Russian military dictator risen from the ashes of the 1887 revolution and the Siberian defeat at the Obi.
characters.sierpinski_vertex_affinity: Vertex 2 (Feral Survival / The Cornered Wolf)
characters.metaphor_domain: Wolves walled in stone cellars, masons, sheep in the next stall, and spring thaws.
characters.emotional_deflection_or_tell: Leans his scarred, bearded face toward the lamp so his old Yenisei shrapnel-scar gleams white; clinks his heavy boot-spurs behind the table.

characters.name: Nineteen-Year-Old Tubercular Count from Lyons
characters.role_or_significance: Pilot of the lead French dirigible that drops white phosphorus and turpentine on London.
characters.social_and_cultural_background: Impoverished French provincial nobility serving in the *Flotte Aérienne de la Revanche*.
characters.sierpinski_vertex_affinity: Vertex 3 (Suicidal Fanaticism)
characters.metaphor_domain: Ballast-racks and steering-wheels.
characters.emotional_deflection_or_tell: Chains himself to the steering-wheel of his hydrogen dirigible to ensure the mission is completed.

characters.name: Junior Prefect / Assessor Adams (Candidate Three-Three-Zero-Nine)
characters.role_or_significance: Young Polytechnic prefect who calmly surveys the burning of London from Greenwich, conducts the demographic census of conquered Europe, and later works frantically in the Thalassia Chart-Vault during the 1919 crisis.
characters.social_and_cultural_background: Graduate of the Seattle Polytechnic class.
characters.sierpinski_vertex_affinity: Vertex 1 (Surveying & Demographic Accounting)
characters.syntax_and_rhythm: In London, cool and detached; in the 1919 Thalassia vault, shouting, breathless, and overwhelmed by cascading system failures.
characters.metaphor_domain: Demolition-dynamite, foreclosure warrants, Roman brick, repeater-cables, and flooded mine-shafts.
characters.emotional_deflection_or_tell: Wipes a flake of greasy Thames soot from his celluloid collar while calculating how much dynamite the London fire will save; later elbows through knee-deep telegraph tape in a sweat-and-oil-soaked shirt.

characters.name: Malia
characters.role_or_significance: Lady Kaiulani's forty-year-old niece and secretary in the Insular Secretariat who reads the war-profiteering ledgers of the Neutrality Syndicate.
characters.social_and_cultural_background: Hawaiian royal family member integrated into the civil service of Thalassia.
characters.sierpinski_vertex_affinity: Vertex 1 (Clerical Precision) & Vertex 3 (Familial Care)
characters.syntax_and_rhythm: Low, clear, rhythmic reading of financial and commodity ledgers.
characters.metaphor_domain: Nitrates, lubricating-oil, machine-tool patents, and specie balances.
characters.emotional_deflection_or_tell: Steadily turns rice-paper ledger pages against the sea-breeze while sliding her finger down columns of violet figures.

characters.name: Citizen-Syndic Hugenberg
characters.role_or_significance: Syndic for the Third Rhine Canton who protests the de-industrialization and demographic conscription of Europe in the Berlin Reichstag.
characters.social_and_cultural_background: Former director of the Essen steel-works in Germany.
characters.sierpinski_vertex_affinity: Vertex 2 (Industrial & Physical Survival of a Conquered People)
characters.metaphor_domain: Coal and pig-iron output, blast-furnaces, and winter wheat.
characters.speech_quirks_or_dialect: Thick, hesitant German-accented English; uses forced imperial titles ('Citizen-Chancellor').
characters.emotional_deflection_or_tell: Bears a purple scurvy carbuncle on his cheek; raises a trembling hand holding a balance-sheet, then sinks back onto the iron bench and buries his grey face in his hands.

characters.name: Sub-Deacon of the Roman Curia
characters.role_or_significance: Representative of the Vatican at the signing of the Geneva Accord.
characters.social_and_cultural_background: Roman Catholic clergy.
characters.sierpinski_vertex_affinity: Vertex 3 (Broken Religious Institution)
characters.metaphor_domain: Mud-stained soutanes.
characters.emotional_deflection_or_tell: Trembles visibly before Kaiulani's table.

characters.name: Former Federal Councillor of the Swiss Cantons
characters.role_or_significance: Swiss representative at the signing of the Geneva Accord.
characters.social_and_cultural_background: Swiss republican magistrate reduced to penury.
characters.sierpinski_vertex_affinity: Vertex 2 (Material Destitution)
characters.metaphor_domain: Hempen twine replacing a gold watch-chain.
characters.emotional_deflection_or_tell: Wears a piece of hempen twine where his gold watch-chain used to be.

characters.name: General von Seeckt
characters.role_or_significance: Representative of the dissolved German Quartermaster Staff at Geneva who asks only for a guarantee of the municipal salt-ration.
characters.social_and_cultural_background: Prussian general staff officer.
characters.sierpinski_vertex_affinity: Vertex 1 (Quartermaster Logistics) reduced to Vertex 2 (Bare Subsistence)
characters.metaphor_domain: Municipal salt-rations and river customs.
characters.emotional_deflection_or_tell: Left arm strapped in a pasteboard splint; his solitary hand twitches involuntarily toward his empty sword-belt.

characters.name: Commander Hirose
characters.role_or_significance: Captain of the dispatch-cruiser *Manila* steaming through the Strait of Messina.
characters.social_and_cultural_background: Born in the Nagasaki naval wards; thirty-two-year-old graduate of the Berkeley sheds.
characters.sierpinski_vertex_affinity: Vertex 1 (Naval Routine & Imperial Tourism)
characters.metaphor_domain: Grain-convoys, electric tramways, and Sunday photography.
characters.speech_quirks_or_dialect: Polite Berkeley officer's English; treats ancient European civilization as a curated museum park.
characters.emotional_deflection_or_tell: Examines Mount Etna and the ruins of Magna Graecia with the mild, detached curiosity of a botanist looking at a pressed fern.

characters.name: Chief Surgeon Takagi
characters.role_or_significance: Naval surgeon at the Gibraltar coal-hulks whose autopsy dispatch identifies the lethal 'Rhine-Mud Grippe'.
characters.social_and_cultural_background: Japanese-Pacifica military medical corps.
characters.sierpinski_vertex_affinity: Vertex 1 (Medical Pathology) confronting Vertex 2 (Biological Contagion)
characters.metaphor_domain: Black frothy blood and wet slate skin.
characters.emotional_deflection_or_tell: None directly observed (appears via cable dispatch).

characters.name: Senior Sanitary Prefect Watanabe
characters.role_or_significance: Administrator overseeing the soup-lines, charter-burnings, and wrist-shackling of the Austrian population in the Vienna Heldenplatz.
characters.social_and_cultural_background: Japanese-Pacifica sanitary magistrate.
characters.sierpinski_vertex_affinity: Vertex 1 (Biopolitical Economy & Population Control)
characters.metaphor_domain: Machine-gun rounds versus salt-pork, carbolic soap, turnstiles, and numbered clerks.
characters.speech_quirks_or_dialect: Clinical bureaucratic English muffled through a eucalyptus-camphor gauze mask.
characters.emotional_deflection_or_tell: Watches three centuries of Hapsburg charters burn in his spectacles' reflection while holding a stamped aluminum clipboard.

characters.name: Aged Austrian Archduke
characters.role_or_significance: Last cousin of Charles the Fifth who surrenders his patent of nobility for soup and a riveted wrist-tag in Vienna.
characters.social_and_cultural_background: House of Hapsburg-Lorraine.

characters.metaphor_domain: Moth-eaten fur pelisse and brass wrist-shackles.
characters.emotional_deflection_or_tell: Hesitates for three seconds at the anvil, then thrusts his wasted white wrist into the brass shackle without lifting his eyes to the palace eagles.

characters.name: Samoan Blacksmith-Corporal
characters.role_or_significance: Enlisted technician riveting permanent lead-and-brass ration-tags onto the wrists of Viennese citizens.
characters.social_and_cultural_background: Samoan recruit in the Imperial Pacific Relief Commission.
characters.sierpinski_vertex_affinity: Vertex 2 (Physical Labor & Assembly-Line Enforcement)
characters.metaphor_domain: Files, tongs, and anvils.
characters.speech_quirks_or_dialect: Flat, clipped pidgin of the Monterey depots ('Next in the file!').
characters.emotional_deflection_or_tell: Takes an imperial patent of nobility with iron tongs to throw into the furnace and taps his rivet-hammer once against the block.

characters.name: Emperor Kalanimoku
characters.role_or_significance: Sacred Emperor of the Grand Confederation; grandson of Lady Kaiulani and Elias Thorne, whose rigid insistence on mathematical infallibility and military expansion accelerates the empire's collapse.
characters.social_and_cultural_background: Third-generation Oahu-born monarch raised in the syncretic, technocratic court of Thalassia, attempting to emulate his mainland grandfather's frontier ruthlessness through bureaucratic fiat.
characters.sierpinski_vertex_affinity: Vertex 1 (Absolute obsession with ledgers, capital valuation, and macroscopic imperial geometry).

characters.metaphor_domain: Structural engineering, canal locks, accounting balances, railway ballast.
characters.speech_quirks_or_dialect: Speaks with a 'hard, gravelly frontier cadence learned from the wax cylinders' of Elias Thorne, later degenerating into silent, painted paralysis.
characters.emotional_deflection_or_tell: Secludes himself in fortified chart-rooms or floating pontoons; reduces human catastrophe (like gassed cadets) to 'acceptable structural loss'.

characters.name: Fleet-General Kuroda
characters.role_or_significance: Veteran supreme commander of the Combined Pacific Corps who leads the disastrous 1919 invasion of the Kingdom of Kabul and is crushed to death in the Kurd-Kabul defile.
characters.social_and_cultural_background: Satsuma-Californian naval and military elite; hero of the Great Indian War (sinking the British fleet at the Hooghly).
characters.sierpinski_vertex_affinity: Vertex 1 (Strategic logistics, geopolitical perimeter control, ruthless battlefield command).
characters.syntax_and_rhythm: Barking, imperative military commands and crisp strategic aphorisms.
characters.metaphor_domain: Architecture of security ('unbolted door', 'hole in the fence'), artillery trajectories.
characters.speech_quirks_or_dialect: Quiet Monterey baritone ruined into a 'frost-bitten rasp' by the Hindu Kush winter.
characters.emotional_deflection_or_tell: Clutches a useless duralumin circular calculator in his frost-blackened hand; ignores dead subordinates to order canister fire through his own retreating debtor-troops.

characters.name: Junior Prefect Adams
characters.role_or_significance: Auditor from Thalassia killed by a ricocheting jezail slug in the Kurd-Kabul defile while carrying the November audit-rolls.
characters.social_and_cultural_background: Oahu/Thalassia bureaucratic caste, scholarly and physically unsuited for mountain warfare.
characters.sierpinski_vertex_affinity: Vertex 1 (Embodies the literal carrying of the bureaucratic ledger into the wilderness).
characters.metaphor_domain: Audit rolls, manila census cards.
characters.emotional_deflection_or_tell: Clings to his haversack of manila cards until his blood freezes over them.

characters.name: Colonel Kalakaua the younger
characters.role_or_significance: Thirty-year-old officer who reports the rout of the Bavarian debtor-company in the Khyber pass while mortally wounded.
characters.social_and_cultural_background: Polynesian military aristocracy, graduate of the Oahu academy.
characters.sierpinski_vertex_affinity: Vertex 2 (Immediate physical trauma, tactile horror of the breakdown of weapons and flesh in the snow).
characters.syntax_and_rhythm: Breathless, urgent compound sentences driven by panic and physical pain.
characters.metaphor_domain: Butchery, freezing grease, physical mutilation.
characters.speech_quirks_or_dialect: Standard military English breaking under extreme high-altitude shock.
characters.emotional_deflection_or_tell: Clutches a nine-inch Afghan choora knife-wound in his ribs while reporting tactical collapse.

characters.name: Brigadier / Marshal Marcus Vance the third
characters.role_or_significance: Grand-nephew of Field-Marshal Marcus Vance; incompetent, terrified technocrat who fails in Kabul, commits the Innokentyevskaya gas massacre, fails in the Mekong delta, and is finally murdered by his own mute guards in 1931.
characters.social_and_cultural_background: Third-generation military peerage; first in the class of 1912 at Thalassia Staff College, educated entirely in air-conditioned glass vaults.
characters.sierpinski_vertex_affinity: Vertex 1 twisted by Vertex 3 (Uses logarithmic valuations and General Orders to mask profound personal cowardice and paranoia).
characters.syntax_and_rhythm: Shrill, frantic imperatives and rigid citations of military regulations.
characters.metaphor_domain: Counting-houses, trigonometric optimization, pest extermination ('wharf-rats', 'water in a trough').
characters.speech_quirks_or_dialect: Voice repeatedly breaks into a 'thin, reedy falsetto' or a 'metallic whistle' (after his nose is broken) when terrified.
characters.emotional_deflection_or_tell: Involuntary twitching of his purple pine-resin burn scar ('like a galvanized frog's leg'); fumbles with his gold pince-nez, circular calculator, or cologne-soaked handkerchief.

characters.name: Sergeant-Major O’Higgins
characters.role_or_significance: Sixty-year-old veteran non-commissioned officer who tries to save the column in the Kurd-Kabul defile by defying young Marcus Vance's suicidal obsession with the tax-rolls.
characters.social_and_cultural_background: Irish-Californian frontier soldier; survivor of the elder Vance's Donner Pass rear-guard thirty-two years prior.
characters.sierpinski_vertex_affinity: Vertex 2 (Pragmatic survival, physical grit, vernacular common sense against abstract bureaucracy).

characters.speech_quirks_or_dialect: Irish-American military vernacular ('by God', 'you little counting-house fool').
characters.emotional_deflection_or_tell: Reacts to bureaucratic insanity with immediate physical action—dragging officers behind dead camels or smashing ammunition padlocks with his carbine butt.

characters.name: Ghilzai Grandfather
characters.role_or_significance: Eighty-year-old Afghan tribesman who drops a blazing fire-pot of pine-resin and camel-dung onto Marcus Vance's treasury-van, igniting the slaughter of the baggage train.

characters.sierpinski_vertex_affinity: Vertex 2 (Pure physical asymmetry—using elemental fire, gravity, and dung against an industrial army).

characters.speech_quirks_or_dialect: None recorded (joins the ululating war-cry of the hills).
characters.emotional_deflection_or_tell: Economizes his lead bullets in favor of a forty-pound clay fire-pot.

characters.name: Field-Marshal Marcus Vance (the Elder)
characters.role_or_significance: Aged, lame military architect of the Empire and lifelong companion to Kaiulani; gives her his greatcoat at Suez and accompanies her into exile at Kalaupapa after his grand-nephew's gas massacre.
characters.social_and_cultural_background: First-generation Californian military elite, veteran of the Donner Pass and continental unification wars.
characters.sierpinski_vertex_affinity: Vertex 3 (Silent, personal loyalty to Kaiulani and quiet horror at the perversion of his martial legacy).
characters.metaphor_domain: Coarse wool, camphor, tarred hemp.
characters.emotional_deflection_or_tell: His face turns 'the color of wet salt-cod' looking at the Irkutsk photographs; sits uncovered and silent at Kaiulani's feet.

characters.name: Ahmad Shah Qajar
characters.role_or_significance: Twenty-two-year-old King of Kings of Persia who takes Pacifica silver bribes in Tehran to guard the Mesopotamian oil flank.

characters.sierpinski_vertex_affinity: Vertex 2 (Purely sensual, opportunistic greed).
characters.metaphor_domain: Uncut diamonds, silver coins.
characters.emotional_deflection_or_tell: Leans over his bolster to dig pudgy fingers into spilled silver thalers 'like a child in a sand-heap'.

characters.name: The Warlord of the Bakhtiari (The Khan / Sardar)
characters.role_or_significance: Persian tribal cavalry leader who negotiates with the dying Kaiulani, extorting silver, carbines, and artillery in exchange for patrolling the eastern desert.
characters.social_and_cultural_background: Nomadic mountain warlord of the Bakhtiari horse-tribes, veteran of frontier mercenary politics.
characters.sierpinski_vertex_affinity: Vertex 2 (Tactile assessment of weapons, seasonal grass, and the shifting balance of physical weakness vs. strength).

characters.emotional_deflection_or_tell: Spits roasted pumpkin-seed husks into the brazier; scratches his lice against his bandoliers; ignores the silver coins to test the bolt action of a new carbine.

characters.name: Junior Prefect / Senior Auditor Hoshino (the younger)
characters.role_or_significance: Devoted aide to Lady Kaiulani in Tehran who is later sent to audit the Siberian copper pits and is shot dead by mutinous French and German locomotive firemen at Mining-Sector Nine.
characters.social_and_cultural_background: Second-generation Japanese-Pacific administrative nobility; his father burned to death in naphtha on the Hankow steps thirty-two years prior.
characters.sierpinski_vertex_affinity: Vertex 1 (Devoted to parity-checks, Hollerith cards, and administrative order even in sub-zero mutiny).

characters.metaphor_domain: Parity-checks, gondola quotas, telegraph repeaters.
characters.emotional_deflection_or_tell: Taps the dead brass key of his field-telegraph; hammers with bare fists against the armored bulkhead of the hijacked locomotive.

characters.name: Tank-Commander Lieutenant Sato (Candidate 0922)
characters.role_or_significance: Commander of a forty-ton Leviathan steam-tank in the Panjshir valley whose machine is disabled and blinded by Afghan tribesmen using soapstone pits and quartz-sand.

characters.sierpinski_vertex_affinity: Vertex 1 colliding with Vertex 2 (Arrogant faith in Krupp armor and steam-gauges shattered by primitive physical sabotage).

characters.metaphor_domain: Armor plate thickness, rail gauges, target valuation.
characters.emotional_deflection_or_tell: Wipes cylinder-grease from his chin and taps the brass steam-gauge right before disaster strikes.

characters.name: Barefoot Afghan Boy
characters.role_or_significance: Sixteen-year-old insurgent in the Panjshir valley who leaps onto Lieutenant Sato's tank and destroys its engine by pouring quartz-sand and sheep-dung down the blower intake.
characters.social_and_cultural_background: Tajik/Ghilzai mountain youth raised in the high valleys of the Hindu Kush.
characters.sierpinski_vertex_affinity: Vertex 2 (Weaponizes raw dirt, agility, and a shepherd's crowbar against forty tons of steel).

characters.name: Prefect-Chancellor Shen (the third)

characters.social_and_cultural_background: Third-generation Sino-Pacific bureaucratic elite, raised at the pinnacle of the Bureau of Integration.
characters.sierpinski_vertex_affinity: Vertex 1 collapsing into Vertex 3 (A man of pure tabular logic driven to frantic, paranoid terror when the Emperor turns the audit machinery inward).
