characters.metaphor_domain: Constitutional statutes, clearing-house circuits, decimal points, opium balances.
characters.speech_quirks_or_dialect: Cool Berkeley engineering prose in bulletins; high-pitched screaming loyalty when arrested.
characters.emotional_deflection_or_tell: Sweat fogging his tape-mended spectacles; hands trembling on the brass furnace poker while darting his eyes toward ceiling microphones.

characters.name: Senior Senator Wu
characters.role_or_significance: Representative of the Forty-Sixth Yangtze Canton who leads the historic 1920 Senate revolt refusing Emperor Kalanimoku's ninety-million-thaler war appropriation.
characters.social_and_cultural_background: First-Class Polytechnic graduate and syndicate-factor of the Hankow Iron Trust.
characters.sierpinski_vertex_affinity: Vertex 1 (Mercantile and industrial pragmatism rebelling against unprofitable imperial overextension).
characters.metaphor_domain: Discount rates, pig-iron tonnage,
characters.speech_quirks_or_dialect: Loud, authoritative English delivered across the Senate floor.
characters.emotional_deflection_or_tell: Steps into the central aisle shaking a fistful of depreciated Market Street Treasury notes at the podium.

characters.name: Assessor Miller (of the Third Sacramento Canton)
characters.role_or_significance: Californian senator who joins Senator Wu in the 1920 budget revolt, protesting the loss of agricultural labor and gold reserves to the Afghan war.
characters.social_and_cultural_background: Agrarian-industrial syndicate elite representing the San Joaquin grain and orchard trusts.
characters.sierpinski_vertex_affinity: Vertex 1/2 hybrid (Ties financial gold reserves directly to rotting fruit and frostbitten harvest hands).
characters.metaphor_domain: Rotting orchards, frostbitten toes, vault percentages.
characters.emotional_deflection_or_tell: Slams his koa-wood desk lid so hard the brass ink-horn leaps out and rolls down the steps.

characters.name: Senior Engineer-Prefect / Junior Minister Sato
characters.role_or_significance: Older brother of Tank-Commander Sato; witnesses the retreat from the Khyber Pass at Jamrud in 1920, rises to Junior/Senior Minister by the 1930 Centennial, and is assassinated with hydrocyanic acid in 1931.
characters.social_and_cultural_background: High-ranking Japanese-Pacific technocrat who transitions from frontier engineering to the decadent, white-powdered court nobility of Thalassia.
characters.sierpinski_vertex_affinity: Vertex 1 (Deeply understands that the Empire's survival rests on the psychological myth of mathematical infallibility, even when the dials are rigged).
characters.syntax_and_rhythm: Measured, fatalistic observations in 1920; stiff, courtly recitations of falsified data in 1930.
characters.metaphor_domain: Laws of nature (monsoons, tides), geometry ('the circumference has a crack'), commodity indices.
characters.emotional_deflection_or_tell: In 1920, his fingers tremble so hard his circular calculator drops from his belt; in 1930, his left cheek twitches beneath heavy white lead face-powder while reciting fake coal statistics.

characters.name: Rajput Subadar
characters.role_or_significance: Native officer of the Autonomous Rajput Lancers at Jamrud Fort who silently signals the end of Pacifica prestige as the Khyber rails are pulled up.
characters.social_and_cultural_background: Hereditary Indian warrior caste integrated into the Pacifica colonial auxiliary forces.
characters.sierpinski_vertex_affinity: Vertex 2 (Visceral, non-verbal recognition of physical retreat and weakness).
characters.metaphor_domain: Smoke and betel-juice.
characters.emotional_deflection_or_tell: While buttoned to the chin in strict Monterey regulation, he turns his head toward the burning railway sleepers and spits a red stream of betel-juice squarely onto the telegraph-office threshold.

characters.name: Oahu Corporal in Tower Two
characters.role_or_significance: Nineteen-year-old sentry at the Krasny-Yar copper pit in Siberia who tries to quell the debtor uprising before his frozen Maxim gun jams and his tower is blown up with nitro-glycerine.
characters.social_and_cultural_background: Young Hawaiian conscript exhausted by three months of double-watch in sub-arctic conditions.
characters.sierpinski_vertex_affinity: Vertex 2 (Victim of physical cold and mechanical failure).
characters.syntax_and_rhythm: Formulaic guard commands barked through a megaphone.
characters.metaphor_domain: Gruel rations, ore-switches.
characters.emotional_deflection_or_tell: Wraps his hands in greasy rags around the frozen water-jacket of his useless machine gun.

characters.name: Prussian Pioneer-Major
characters.role_or_significance: Deportee labor leader at the Krasny-Yar pit who initiates the great Siberian rebellion by having his wrist-shackle sheared off on an anvil and announcing the defeat in Kabul.
characters.social_and_cultural_background: Former officer of the Imperial German Army reduced to a numbered slave-mason under the Brussels Liquidation Accord.
characters.sierpinski_vertex_affinity: Vertex 2/3 (Combines physical defiance of pain with collective brotherhood among the multi-national debtors).
characters.syntax_and_rhythm: Resonant, rhythmic battle-cries designed to be repeated across a canyon.
characters.metaphor_domain: Broken tracks, burning tanks, frozen water-guns.
characters.emotional_deflection_or_tell: Holds his bleeding wrist high into the violet glare of the carbon-arcs and flings his brass number-plate straight into the melting-pot.

characters.name: Russian Forge-Striker
characters.role_or_significance: Bearded debtor-smith at Krasny-Yar who swings a ten-pound hammer to shear the Monterey rivet off the Prussian major's wrist.
characters.social_and_cultural_background: Russian veteran of Brusilov's dissolved regiments deported to the Siberian mines.
characters.sierpinski_vertex_affinity: Vertex 2 (Pure physical force and metallurgical skill turned against captivity).
characters.metaphor_domain: Hammer and anvil.
characters.emotional_deflection_or_tell: Executes a single, precise, heavy blow on the anvil next to the white-hot coals.

characters.name: French Fireman from Lyons
characters.role_or_significance: Deportee locomotive fireman on the Siberian audit-train who kills the Californian cadet-engineer with a coal-pick and shoots Senior Auditor Hoshino dead.
characters.social_and_cultural_background: Former French locomotive-artificer from Lyons enslaved in the Siberian railway service.
characters.sierpinski_vertex_affinity: Vertex 2 (Lethal, opportunistic physical reclamation of the machine he operates).
characters.metaphor_domain: Coal-picks and revolvers.
characters.emotional_deflection_or_tell: Leans out of the cab window with a soot-blackened fist to fire twice into the auditor's chest.

characters.name: Flight-Captain / Captain Noguchi
characters.role_or_significance: Airship commander of the Vengeance of Oahu and later naval aide on the cruiser Monterey; reluctantly executes Marcus Vance's order to gas Innokentyevskaya, serves him at Sydney, and dies in 1931 after licking a poisoned telegraph envelope.
characters.social_and_cultural_background: Professional Japanese-Pacific military officer caught between traditional honor/humanity and the psychotic orders of his superior.
characters.sierpinski_vertex_affinity: Vertex 1 conflicted by Vertex 3 (Operates the high-tech instruments of mass murder while haunted by the human cost to cadets and women).
characters.syntax_and_rhythm: Precise technical reporting interrupted by hesitant moral objections.
characters.metaphor_domain: Thermal inversions, barometric pressure, artillery ricochets.
characters.speech_quirks_or_dialect: Quiet, deferential military English with a suppressed tremor in his throat.
characters.emotional_deflection_or_tell: Pauses his gloved hand half an inch above the brass telegraph-handle before releasing the phosgene; speaks quietly at Sydney so the quartermaster cannot hear his fear.

characters.name: Captain Takahashi
characters.role_or_significance: Commander of the Nineteenth Satsuma Provosts at Pumping-Station Six in Malaya; his skull is blown off by a Ukrainian sniper during the jungle ambush.
characters.social_and_cultural_background: Japanese military provost officer fighting malaria and insurgency in the equatorial rubber belt.
characters.sierpinski_vertex_affinity: Vertex 2 (Immersed in the tactile misery of heat, mud, malaria, and failing chemical weapons).
characters.syntax_and_rhythm: Weary, observational field reports shifting to sharp combat commands.
characters.metaphor_domain: Jungle canopies, poisoned fish, hot breech-blocks.
characters.emotional_deflection_or_tell: Continuously wipes greenish sweat from the breech-block of his hot Maxim gun with an oily rag.

characters.name: Lieutenant Miller (at Pahang River)
characters.role_or_significance: Nineteen-year-old officer from the Oakland sheds who takes over the Maxim gun after Takahashi's death and tries to shut the main oil pump-valve before the Belgian artilleryman ignites the gorge.
characters.social_and_cultural_background: Young Californian Polytechnic subaltern thrust into tropical guerrilla warfare.
characters.sierpinski_vertex_affinity: Vertex 2 (Frantic physical struggle with jammed belts and flooding petroleum).
characters.metaphor_domain: Lamp-wicks, flood-valves.
characters.emotional_deflection_or_tell: Jabs frantically at a jammed canvas ammunition belt with his bayonet over his captain's headless body.

characters.name: Belgian Artilleryman
characters.role_or_significance: Escaped European deportee in the Malayan jungle who hurls a flaming ball of rubber-latex and coconut-husk into the ruptured Pahang oil pipeline, destroying Pumping-Station Six.
characters.social_and_cultural_background: Former Belgian soldier bearing a six-digit debtor-scar burned across his forearm.
characters.sierpinski_vertex_affinity: Vertex 2 (Improvised, elemental guerrilla warfare).
characters.metaphor_domain: Sling and fire.
characters.emotional_deflection_or_tell: Stands up bare-chested in the open mud for a single second to whirl his braided rattan sling.

characters.name: Lieutenant-Commander Brooks
characters.role_or_significance: Exhausted commander of the river monitor Tonkin in the Mekong delta who explains to Marcus Vance why their ship is immobilized by rebel wire and water-hyacinths.
characters.social_and_cultural_background: Anglo-Californian naval engineering officer broken by forty days of sleepless counter-insurgency in Cochin-China.
characters.sierpinski_vertex_affinity: Vertex 2 (Grounded in the mechanical and environmental reality of fouled paddle-shafts, mud, and sea-breezes versus Vance's delusions).
characters.syntax_and_rhythm: Flat, deadpan, matter-of-fact explanations of total tactical futility.
characters.metaphor_domain: Fouled machinery, warm mud, wind direction.
characters.emotional_deflection_or_tell: Does not even flinch when a poisoned four-foot bamboo blow-dart sticks quivering into the chart-table beside him; wipes his brow with a greasy forearm over prickly-heat sores.

characters.name: Inspector of the Verification Board
characters.role_or_significance: Twenty-year-old secret police agent checking travel-warrants and wrist-stamps in the subterranean vaults of Thalassia during the Great Purge.
characters.social_and_cultural_background: Fanatical young recruit of the Palace Secret Police (accompanied by a partner from the Nagasaki wards).
characters.sierpinski_vertex_affinity: Vertex 1 (Rigid enforcement of biometric and serial verification).
characters.metaphor_domain: Perforators, serial stamps.
characters.emotional_deflection_or_tell: Bars the turnstile physically while his partner inspects wrist-tattoos with a magnifying glass.

characters.name: Chief Mechanical Prefect Ozawa
characters.role_or_significance: Twenty-four-year-old cyborg administrator of Automated Imperial Wool-and-Ordnance Complex Number Four in Melbourne who fires steam-mortars into starving, locked-out workers.
characters.social_and_cultural_background: Graduate of the Osaka Cybernetic Institute; lost his left arm in the Chita explosion, replacing it with a jointed steel prosthetic hook.
characters.sierpinski_vertex_affinity: Vertex 1 (The ultimate extreme of Polytechnic logic: viewing human biology itself as an unacceptable statistical variance).
characters.syntax_and_rhythm: Chillingly calm, balanced, analytical sentences delivered amidst electrocution and shrapnel.
characters.metaphor_domain: Caloric inputs, statistical variance in shell driving-bands, mineral oil consumption, memory erasure.
characters.speech_quirks_or_dialect: 'Flat Osaka English' devoid of emotional inflection.
characters.emotional_deflection_or_tell: Uses his steel prosthetic hook to turn up the high-voltage rheostat on the barbed wire and pull the mortar trip-lever without changing his vocal tone.

characters.name: Melbourne Foundry-Smith (Panama Veteran)
characters.role_or_significance: Grey-bearded giant in a leather apron who begs Prefect Ozawa to open the manual lathes at half-ration before leading the charge against the power pylon.
characters.social_and_cultural_background: Australian/Yorkshire industrial worker; veteran of the 1914 Panama Concrete Gang (still wearing his bronze medal).
characters.sierpinski_vertex_affinity: Vertex 2 (Desperate physical hunger, pride in manual labor, and raw muscular revolt against automation).
characters.syntax_and_rhythm: Booming, desperate ultimatum shouted through sleet.
characters.metaphor_domain: Barley-meal, bare hands vs. concrete dynamos.
characters.emotional_deflection_or_tell: Holds up a cold iron hammer and an empty tin pannikin toward the automated cannery steam-flues.

characters.name: Higgins (the Salt-Boiler)
characters.role_or_significance: One-legged former telegraph-clerk living in the ruins of San Francisco who guides the Chronicler both above ground (viewing the Sanctuary-Ark) and down into the subterranean Cathedral of the Unnumbered.
characters.social_and_cultural_background: Discarded lower-tier Anglo-Californian clerk surviving on the margins by boiling salt out of toxic bay-mud.
characters.sierpinski_vertex_affinity: Vertex 2 (Cynical, street-level survivor navigating the physical decay of the metropolis).
characters.syntax_and_rhythm: Rhythmic, observational, bitterly ironic compound sentences.
characters.metaphor_domain: Pearl dinner-buttons, freezer-ships, mud and salt.
characters.emotional_deflection_or_tell: Spits down into the greasy black water beside a bloated horse carcass while describing the luxuries of the First Class.

characters.name: Old Kahuku
characters.role_or_significance: Seventy-year-old one-eyed canoe-steersman from Niihau who guides the rebel stoker Keawe through the dynamited Koloa reef to Lady Kaiulani's hut.
characters.social_and_cultural_background: Indigenous Hawaiian maritime elder whose grandsons all died in the Bengal landing-craft during the Indian War.
characters.sierpinski_vertex_affinity: Vertex 3 (Silent ancestral fidelity and grief driving his aid to the anti-imperial underground).
characters.metaphor_domain: Surf, reefs, night navigation.
characters.emotional_deflection_or_tell: Moves like a shadow through the sulfurous mist and dives headlong through the rear thatch when the Choshu patrol arrives.

characters.name: Keawe (Stamped 77402)
characters.role_or_significance: Charismatic mixed-race fleet-stoker who seeks Kaiulani's royal thumbprint in 1921 for a naval mutiny, and by 1930 emerges as the prophet-leader of the subterranean Cathedral of the Unnumbered in San Francisco.
characters.social_and_cultural_background: Born of the empire's lower decks (Oahu boatman cheekbones, Cantonese furnace-man eyes); former Osaka rolling-mill worker and flagship stoker with a chiseled-off ration-shackle scar.
characters.sierpinski_vertex_affinity: Vertex 3 fused with Vertex 2 (Channels the tactile misery of the boiler-rooms into a fierce, syncretic religious-revolutionary brotherhood).
characters.syntax_and_rhythm: Incantatory, rhythmic, liturgical cadence built on parallelisms and visceral maritime imagery.
characters.metaphor_domain: Shovels, boiler-rooms, iron chains on the earth's chest, walking along the bottom of the water, the Pure Land rising from mud.
characters.speech_quirks_or_dialect: Master of the 'Creole of the Lower Decks' (a bastard tongue of Cantonese, English, Tagalog, and Polynesian) as well as prophetic revolutionary English.
characters.emotional_deflection_or_tell: Wears Kaiulani's kukui-soot thumbprint on crimson silk pinned over his heart; laughs aloud through broken teeth on the floor even after his legs are shattered by bullets.

characters.name: Brother Ivan (of the Baikal Pits)
characters.role_or_significance: Gaunt, one-eyed Russian deportee who volunteers as the lead suicide-diver in the San Francisco sewer-outfall plot to blow up the New Thalassia pontoons.
characters.social_and_cultural_background: Survivor of the Siberian copper-pit massacres who escaped to the Californian underground.
characters.sierpinski_vertex_affinity: Vertex 3 (Martyrdom and fanatical devotion to the syncretic faith of the Unnumbered).
characters.syntax_and_rhythm: Short, serene, ritualistic acceptance of death.
characters.metaphor_domain: The Pure Land, the broken chain.
characters.emotional_deflection_or_tell: Kisses the red glass eye of the copper Marx-Bodhisattva before his helmet is bolted down; later spits bloody phlegm onto Marcus Vance's patent-leather boot.

characters.name: Lieutenant-Assessor Hoshino (of the Submarine Guard)
characters.role_or_significance: Twenty-six-year-old elite naval officer and ordnance-aide to Marcus Vance who is unmasked inside the fourth suicide-diving suit in the Mission Street sewer.
characters.social_and_cultural_background: Grandson of the old Hankow auditor (and nephew/son of the Hoshino killed in Siberia); First-Class Monterey Staff Academy graduate who defects to the Cathedral of the Unnumbered.
characters.sierpinski_vertex_affinity: Vertex 3 conquering Vertex 1 (A scion of the highest bureaucratic caste who turns his precision training toward self-sacrificial revolutionary terror).
characters.metaphor_domain: Military rosters and tactical surprises.
characters.speech_quirks_or_dialect: Speaks 'the crisp English of the First Class examination-halls' while wearing four hundred pounds of nitro-gelatine.
characters.emotional_deflection_or_tell: Maintains calm, heavy-lidded composure and neat uniform discipline (tucking his collar inside the diving flange) while announcing the mutiny of Vance's own guards.

characters.name: Chief / Junior Assessor MacArthur
characters.role_or_significance: Pale-faced nephew of the late rebellious Australian Senator MacArthur; explains the 'frozen salamander' sabotage at Port Kembla to the Chronicler and later serves as Marcus Vance's terrified watch-officer in the Pearl Lochs bunker.
characters.social_and_cultural_background: Anglo-Australian administrative nobility clinging to the collapsing remnants of the Chancellery apparatus.
characters.sierpinski_vertex_affinity: Vertex 1 decaying under Vertex 2 pressure (Analyses industrial paralysis with technical clarity, later reduced to paranoid survival in a poisoned bunker).
characters.syntax_and_rhythm: At Port Kembla: dry, technical exposition; in the bunker: tense, hushed, staccato warnings.
characters.metaphor_domain: Metallurgy (frozen salamanders, diamond-bits), poison (barium-salts), hospital vouchers.
characters.emotional_deflection_or_tell: Chews on an unlighted pipe at Port Kembla; in the bunker, edges sideways along the steel wall with a four-day beard and a drawn revolver to stay clear of Vance's shotgun.

characters.name: Colonel Kalakaua (at Sydney Cove)
characters.role_or_significance: Brother of the Colonel Kalakaua killed in the Khyber Pass; commands the Fourteenth Californian and Satsuma Pacification Regiment on the Sydney quay and is dragged from his horse when his troops refuse to fire on the strikers.
characters.social_and_cultural_background: Hawaiian military nobility loyal to the Thalassia regime to the bitter end.
characters.sierpinski_vertex_affinity: Vertex 1 (Rigid adherence to drill regulations and command hierarchy until physically overthrown).
characters.metaphor_domain: Rifle elevations, saber slashes.
characters.emotional_deflection_or_tell: Turns grey when the rifles stay silent and immediately raises his revolver to execute the first mutinous corporal from behind.

characters.name: Fresno Corporal (of Company A)
characters.role_or_significance: Twenty-year-old Californian soldier on the right flank at Sydney Cove who initiates the mass mutiny of the Fourteenth Regiment by grounding his bayonet and ripping off his birth-cipher.
characters.social_and_cultural_background: Grandson of a pioneer who rode with Caleb Vance at the Truckee River; raised in the Fresno irrigation-wards.
characters.sierpinski_vertex_affinity: Vertex 3/2 (Silent, courageous solidarity with the striking workers, breaking the conditioning of Monterey drill).
characters.syntax_and_rhythm: Silent in text (communicates entirely through deliberate physical ritual).
characters.metaphor_domain: Unfired brass cartridges, bayonets stuck in paving stones, discarded numbers.
characters.emotional_deflection_or_tell: Calmly flicks open his breech-bolt, drives his bayonet upright between granite blocks, tears off his collar number, and sits cross-legged beside a one-armed boilermaker.

characters.name: Tui and Mano
characters.role_or_significance: Six-foot-four mute and deaf Samoan bodyguards of Marshal Marcus Vance who secretly join Keawe's cult and crush Vance's skull inside the Third Sub-Basal Command Bunker.
characters.social_and_cultural_background: Pago-Pago palace guards mutilated in childhood by Imperial surgeons (tongues cut out, eardrums punctured) to make them incorruptible.
characters.sierpinski_vertex_affinity: Vertex 3 (Visceral, silent fanaticism and vengeance expressed through self-mutilation and coordinated lethal violence).
characters.metaphor_domain: Oiled bronze statues, sixty-cycle cams, crimson silk pinned to raw flesh.
characters.speech_quirks_or_dialect: None; communicate via floor vibrations and visual shadows.
characters.emotional_deflection_or_tell: Tui sweats in a cold room as his blood rises before the strike; when killing Vance, Tui opens his mouth to reveal the rebel crimson silk pinned directly to the stump of his severed tongue with a brass safety-pin.

characters.name: Toothless Typesetter
characters.role_or_significance: Old bystander on Montgomery Street in San Francisco who warns the Chronicler to uncover his head as Julian Thorne's column passes.
characters.social_and_cultural_background: Surviving working-class inhabitant of the ruined continental capital.
characters.sierpinski_vertex_affinity: Vertex 2 (Pragmatic street survival in the face of a new violent regime).
characters.metaphor_domain: Hats, pick-handles, and ears.
characters.emotional_deflection_or_tell: Quickly pulls his own greasy cap to his chest as the horsemen draw level.

characters.name: Julian Thorne (The Lord-Restorer)
characters.role_or_significance: Thirty-two-year-old demagogue and putative descendant of Elias Thorne who leads the populist 'Vigilance Pioneer' coup in 1931, overthrows Emperor Kalanimoku on live television, launches a disastrous expedition to Peru, and realizes in despair that his ancestor exhausted the world's frontiers.
characters.social_and_cultural_background: Allegedly the bastard son of a Eureka sawmill-boss and a Nevada stage-actress; bears an uncanny physical resemblance to Elias Thorne and exploits frontier nostalgia and racial resentment through mass media.
characters.sierpinski_vertex_affinity: Vertex 2 theatricality masking Vertex 3 delusion (Performative frontiervitalism and racial grievance that collapses when confronted with the closed geographical ledger of Vertex 1).
characters.syntax_and_rhythm: Publicly: booming, rhythmic, populist theatrical harangues full of violent binaries; privately: frantic, ragged, disillusioned muttering.
characters.metaphor_domain: Iron and beef, mill-stones, uncut timber, unplowed valleys, eating the whole plate and leaving only bones in the cellar.
characters.speech_quirks_or_dialect: Practiced 'harsh, chest-rasping bark' imitating 1850s California pioneers, stripped raw by five months of screaming into neon microphones.
characters.emotional_deflection_or_tell: Wears stage grease-paint and museum-replica clothes (linen duster, 1851 Colts); smashes glass maps and bronze seals with a five-pound track-spiking maul; crawls on his knees across the illuminated world map.

characters.name: Signal-Captain (at the Thalassia Coup)
characters.role_or_significance: Monterey Signal Corps technician who wires the neon Tele-Vision cameras in the Senate House to broadcast Kalanimoku's overthrow.
characters.social_and_cultural_background: Third-tier technical officer who defects to Julian Thorne's Restoration movement.
characters.sierpinski_vertex_affinity: Vertex 1 (Technical facilitator of mass-media statecraft).
characters.metaphor_domain: Wave-lengths, synchronizing discs, 'forty million eyes on the glass'.
characters.emotional_deflection_or_tell: Drops his soldering-iron calmly as the Nipkow discs whine up to speed for the execution spectacle.

characters.name: Cazneau
characters.role_or_significance: Twenty-five-year-old Insular Restoration Guard officer who leads the raid up Waimea canyon, beats Malia, burns the priest's hut, and arrests the ninety-six-year-old Lady Kaiulani.
characters.social_and_cultural_background: Mixed-blood grandson of an American customs-collector at Hilo and a Maui woman, desperate to pass as a 'First Shore' white pioneer.
characters.sierpinski_vertex_affinity: Vertex 3 (Driven by violent racial self-hatred and overcompensating brutality).
characters.syntax_and_rhythm: Aggressive, bullying commands and racial slurs.
characters.metaphor_domain: Spiders in straw, hidden gold chests, flaying skin.
characters.speech_quirks_or_dialect: Harsh English; furiously forbids the speaking of Hawaiian.
characters.emotional_deflection_or_tell: Smears grey wood-ash across his brown cheekbones to pale his skin; flushes dark purple beneath the ash when Malia calls him 'half-breed' in Hawaiian, immediately striking her jaw with his iron megaphone.

characters.name: Kemp
characters.role_or_significance: Sixty-year-old retired hydrographer dragged out of the Monterey almshouse to navigate the transport Sierra during Julian Thorne's doomed 1932 expedition to Peru.
characters.social_and_cultural_background: Old-school maritime navigator of the Polytechnic era, sidelined by automation and then press-ganged after the purge of logarithmic officers.
characters.sierpinski_vertex_affinity: Vertex 1/2 (Uses technical knowledge of boilers and fuel to diagnose the physical absurdity of the Restoration crusade).
characters.metaphor_domain: Lignite smudge, green redwood sleepers, Cortés and ten-thousand-acre ranchos.
characters.emotional_deflection_or_tell: Leans over the blistered iron taffrail pointing a trembling finger at the ragged peat-smoke of the fleet.

characters.name: Vanguard-Colonel Miller (at Callao)
characters.role_or_significance: Red-shirted commander of the landing forces at Callao who demands rebel barricades and Inca gold, only to find starving coolies and an empty mint.
characters.social_and_cultural_background: Californian Vigilance Pioneer officer steeped in Julian Thorne's frontier mythology.
characters.sierpinski_vertex_affinity: Vertex 2/3 (Blustering physical theatricality colliding with economic reality).
characters.metaphor_domain: Rebel barricades, gold reserves, pioneer settlement-land.
characters.emotional_deflection_or_tell: Wades ashore through sewage-fouled surf with a drawn 1851 dragoon pistol in each hand against an unresisting crowd.

characters.name: Senior Canton-Assessor of Callao
characters.role_or_significance: Seventy-year-old Chinese bureaucrat on the Callao seawall who informs Colonel Miller that Peru has been stripped bare for decades and has nothing left to eat but the pioneers' own mules.
characters.social_and_cultural_background: Graduate of the Polytechnic Class of 1884; left behind in the Hundred and Ninth Peruvian Canton until half-blinded by nitrate-flat trachoma.
characters.sierpinski_vertex_affinity: Vertex 1 (The ghost of the bureaucratic ledger delivering the final, devastating audit of imperial exhaustion).
characters.syntax_and_rhythm: exquisitely polite, balanced, conditional sentences ('If your soldiers have brought... if you have brought no barley...').
characters.metaphor_domain: Bullion transfers, dynamo parts, winter barley rations, eating wagon-mules.
characters.speech_quirks_or_dialect: Speaks in 'crisp, archaic Monterey English' of the nineteenth-century academy.
characters.emotional_deflection_or_tell: Bows formally from the waist with two-inch-long fingernails over an empty ledger-board, holding out a rusted key ring and a dead Hollerith sorting-needle.

characters.name: The Imperial Historiographer (The Chronicler)
characters.role_or_significance: First-person narrator and eighty-two-year-old Imperial Historiographer recording the final collapse of the Grand Confederation of Pacifica.
characters.social_and_cultural_background: Educated, cosmopolitan scholar who served Marquis Takashima fifty-eight years ago and walked from Hankow to the Khyber Pass; steeped in classical antiquity (Thucydides) and state archives.
characters.sierpinski_vertex_affinity: Vertex 1 (Statecraft, historical synthesis, grand geopolitical logistics) blended with Vertex 3 (obsessive devotion to the preservation of historical memory).
characters.syntax_and_rhythm: Long, Ciceronian, periodic sentences rich in subordinate clauses, elevated cadences, and elegiac weight.
characters.metaphor_domain: Classical mythology and history (Phlegethon, Piraeus, Caesar), astronomical/nautical instruments (astrolabe, vernier-scale), and organic nature reclaiming industrial iron.
characters.speech_quirks_or_dialect: Formal, archaic-literary Mandarin/English bureaucratic register; addresses younger men as 'boy' and speaks in aphorisms of providence and historical law.
characters.emotional_deflection_or_tell: Retreats into physical writing and archival duty during immediate mortal peril, holding fast to his stylus and scarred left hand while the palace burns around him.

characters.name: Dao
characters.role_or_significance: Young Cantonese amanuensis and last remaining clerk of the Archive who rescues the seventy-eight folio volumes (in eight copper cylinders) and cares for the Chronicler in exile.
characters.social_and_cultural_background: Cantonese bureaucratic clerk trained in the Imperial Archive; later revealed in the Kalalau exile as 'she' (likely having served in male clerical disguise in the Chancellery).
characters.sierpinski_vertex_affinity: Vertex 3 (Deep filial devotion and loyalty to the Master and the preservation of the text).
characters.syntax_and_rhythm: Urgent, breathless declarative sentences during the siege, shifting to hushed, mournful questions on the open ocean and silent, dutiful action in exile.
characters.metaphor_domain: Clerical materials (campaign-rolls, copper cylinders, ink) and broken networks (cold furnaces, cut wires, empty keels).
characters.speech_quirks_or_dialect: Uses respectful titles ('Citizen-Historian', 'Master'); concise and practical speech driven by immediate concern for the Historiographer's survival.
characters.emotional_deflection_or_tell: Clutches the eight copper cylinders tightly against an ink-stained tunic and paddles until blood trickles from the nostrils without uttering a complaint.

characters.name: Keawe
characters.role_or_significance: Forty-year-old revolutionary fleet-stoker and surviving submarine-mechanic who leads the mutiny, spares the Archive, and helps the Chronicler escape.
characters.social_and_cultural_background: Hawaiian working-class machinist and fleet-stoker; veteran of the San Francisco sewer-locks uprising and the coal bunkers.
characters.sierpinski_vertex_affinity: Vertex 2 (Physical survival, tactile mechanical friction, iron, steam, and vernacular labor).
characters.syntax_and_rhythm: Blunt, muscular, grounded sentences with the rhythmic punch of a hammer or piston.
characters.metaphor_domain: Bunkers, hot iron, fire, dry-docks, wire-hawsers, and church burial-services.
characters.speech_quirks_or_dialect: Speaks in the 'rough Creole of the bunkers'; addresses peers as 'brother' and the aged narrator as 'grandfather'.
characters.emotional_deflection_or_tell: Grips his smoking crowbar with a scarred left hand and limps straight back into the burning furnace of the Piazza rather than fleeing to safety.

characters.name: Elias Thorne (The First Protector / The American Caesar)
characters.role_or_significance: Deceased founder of the First Dynasty whose seventy-ton bronze statue (*Colossus of the Meridian*) and flagship (*Elias Thorne*) are destroyed during the fall of Thalassia.
characters.social_and_cultural_background: Nineteenth-century American frontier railway builder, military engineer, and autocratic founder of Pacifica.
characters.sierpinski_vertex_affinity: Vertex 1 (Absolute infrastructural command, railways, telegraphs, and conquest of geography).
characters.syntax_and_rhythm: Non-speaking historical presence; represented through monumental scale and iron permanence.
characters.metaphor_domain: Railway-switches, eighteen-inch cannon, copper wire, and bronze effigies.
characters.emotional_deflection_or_tell: Immortalized with his hand resting upon a bronze railway-switch and his square, bearded face turned toward the Asian sunset.

characters.name: Marquis Takashima
characters.role_or_significance: Historical Japanese nobleman and naval commander who co-founded the geopolitical order with Elias Thorne fifty-eight years earlier.
characters.social_and_cultural_background: High-ranking Japanese aristocrat and naval modernist of the mid-nineteenth century.
characters.sierpinski_vertex_affinity: Vertex 1 (Hemispheric statecraft and naval navigation).
characters.metaphor_domain: Astrolabes, flagships (*Kuroshio*), and Sunset Gold horizons.
characters.emotional_deflection_or_tell: Remembered through his gift of the brass astrolabe to the young Chronicler on the deck of the *Kuroshio*.

characters.name: Barefoot Oregon Timber-Boy
characters.role_or_significance: Young mutineer accompanying Keawe who attempts to burn the Early Protectorate archives with a kerosene torch.
characters.social_and_cultural_background: Starving, unpaid timber-recruit from Oregon brought to the islands by Julian Thorne's vanguard.
characters.sierpinski_vertex_affinity: Vertex 2 (Physical deprivation, raw elements, fire, and physical support).
characters.syntax_and_rhythm: Non-speaking; communicates through physical action and destructive impulse.
characters.metaphor_domain: Pitch-brands, raw kerosene, and timber.
characters.emotional_deflection_or_tell: Readily raises his flaring kerosene torch to burn the vellum racks until physically restrained by Keawe's grip on his wrist.

characters.name: Lead Tractor Megaphone Operator
characters.role_or_significance: Revolutionary rigger atop the lead captured military traction-engine directing the toppling of Elias Thorne's statue.
characters.social_and_cultural_background: Mutinous dockworker or naval mechanic from the Waipahu causeway.
characters.sierpinski_vertex_affinity: Vertex 2 (Tactile mechanical leverage, steam pressure, and collective labor).
characters.syntax_and_rhythm: Short, roaring imperative commands coupled with rhythmic work-chants.
characters.metaphor_domain: Towing-hawsers, slack, and pile-driving.
characters.speech_quirks_or_dialect: Bellows naval/dockyard commands through a salvaged megaphone followed by the Hawaiian working-chant ('Huki! Ho!').
characters.emotional_deflection_or_tell: Channels mass rage into synchronized mechanical rigging and steam-tractor coordination.

characters.name: Three Osaka Court-Peers
characters.role_or_significance: Fleeing aristocrats seen fighting aboard an overturned life-raft in the burning Pearl Lochs.
characters.social_and_cultural_background: High-ranking Japanese-Pacifican court nobility from Osaka accustomed to luxury and synthetic perfumes.
characters.sierpinski_vertex_affinity: Vertex 3 (Feral panic and obsessive self-preservation stripped of courtly veneer).
characters.metaphor_domain: White-leaded makeup, scorched Lyons silk, and splintered pine oars.
characters.emotional_deflection_or_tell: Fight one another with bare teeth and fingernails over a single pair of splintered oars while their silk robes burn.
